sources.recommend_reason_zh: 标题称 Notion 能让用户在不同 AI agents 之间切换而无需重复解释手头工作，但正文实际只显示“Performing security verification”的 CAPTCHA 验证页面，未包含任何实质内容。

en.reason: Codex Desktop continuously generates Crashpad pending dumps, with one user reporting the bug consumed 330GB of Mac disk space while Hacker News commenters trace duplicate git worktree build artifacts, swap use, and an 80GB cleanup with mole.

sources.title_original: Show HN: Sphinx – A hook that quizzes you on your AI's code before shipping
sources.summary:
A Git hook for agent-assisted development. Before your agent’s code ships, Sphinx asks you a question about what it actually does.
“Outsource your thinking, not your understanding .”
— Sun Tzu
Sphinx is a Git hook for agent-assisted development. Before your agent’s code ships, it asks you a question about what that code actually does.
Built to run on minimal tokens, from your existing coding agent, OpenRouter, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
Sphinx
Your webhook handler now saves the event ID
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Sphinx是Git hook，AI代码推送前用diff出题考你，如Stripe重试时先存event ID再charge会否重复扣款或漏单，答错解释再问。

en.reason: Sphinx is a Git hook that quizzes developers on an AI agent's diff before it ships, asking, for example, whether saving a Stripe event ID before charging prevents duplicate or missed charges.

Sometimes the most effective way to getting what I want is just describing a goal really clearly, and then bashing the AI until it gets there. That bashing process can take a lot o
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Show HN 上的 Sphinx 是一个在 shipping AI 代码前用测验考你的 hook，评论区还提到 vibecheck.dev 在 PR 层面拦截合并，并有人指出开发者约每 3 年翻倍、任一时刻约一半人经验不足 3 年。

en.reason: Sphinx is a Show HN hook that quizzes developers on AI-generated code before shipping, while commenters cite vibecheck.dev's PR-level merge interception and note developers double roughly every three years, with about half having under three years' experience.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 作为 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 小更新，称在推理、编码、agentic 任务和视觉基准上提升，缩短执行时间与输出长度，并配套 encoding.py 和 deepseek-recipe Rust 库，采用 MIT License。

en.reason: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, a minor update to DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, claims gains in reasoning, coding, agentic tasks and visual benchmarks while cutting task execution time and output length, shipping with encoding.py and the MIT-licensed deepseek-recipe Rust library.

en.reason: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 is framed as a minor update to DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash yet promises substantial gains in reasoning, coding, agentic tasks and visual benchmarks, with Hacker News commenters calling it stronger than GLM 5.3, near Opus 5, and costly to run locally.
